author: HimDman
quote:
The game was a disappointment 
13 years and two billion dollars for sim’s boyfriend simulator that is more red dead than gta…

Also Jason is the most boring GTA protagonist ever .

Honestly he might be the most boring rockstar protagonist I have ever seen 

The fact that the honour system affects the ending is insane because this is gta not red dead and what’s even more insane is that you have to max out the relationship with Lucia to get another ending lol 

All of this and no gta online in site 

What an absolute let down.
